results.evidence: Exact snapshot unchanged before/after checks. Clean build completes all 12 jobs. Source guard scans 11 Lean files; 75 theorem dependency reports contain only standard propext, Quot.sound, and Classical.choice, with no proof placeholders, custom axioms, or unchecked native-evaluation dependencies. PTX source SHA-256, 3928316 bytes, and 23 manifest anchors verify; 67 local documentation links/fragments resolve; Stratic structure/passage links and whitespace checks pass. Independent proof reviewers cross-reviewed the separately authored reachability/checker/outcome/litmus modules and inspected theorem dependencies. Exact reachability handles nonempty paths, self-loops, empty vertex types, and cycles without a cutoff. check_iff covers every unchanged Graph.Valid field. Complete MP classifications quantify arbitrary words/source/co and include admitted witness directions. Four litmus programs have source-reviewed results and checked program witnesses; paired-rule necessity is itself kernel-checked with pair_required and witness_synchronizes. Independent semantic reviewer found no blocking issue or required correction in code/source correspondence or final docs. Completeness is relative to the existing fragment semantics, not full PTX/hardware semantics; fixed GPU/global/generic, whole-word, immediate-store restrictions persist.
